title: A Label Is a Commitment
description: A category becomes consequential when another system starts acting on it.

title: Categories Are Executable
description: The boundary between two labels is part of the system's behavior.

title: Choose the Evidence Before the Model
description: The right decision rule depends on what must be learned before a label can be justified.

title: Placement Changes the Promise
description: A correct answer can still fail if it arrives too late or describes the wrong moment.

title: Ground Truth Is a Process
description: A reference label earns trust through how it was produced.

title: Accuracy Hides a Question
description: A metric becomes useful when its denominator matches the decision.

title: Rare Events Change the Meaning
description: The same detector can produce very different evidence in a different population.

title: Several Labels, Several Questions
description: Finding some of the truth, finding all of it, and finding the cause are different achievements.

title: Confidence Must Earn Its Meaning
description: Agreement, repeatability, and calibrated confidence answer different questions.

title: Measurement Needs a Memory
description: A dashboard cannot explain change if the instrument forgets how it worked yesterday.
